description: Class representing the settings which are used to create a watermark.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiWatermarkSettings class.

GetDirection.description: Returns the direction of the watermark in the document.

GetImageHeight.description: Returns the height of the watermark image in the document.

returns.description: The watermark image height in EMU.

GetImageURL.description: Returns the image URL of the watermark in the document.

GetImageWidth.description: Returns the width of the watermark image in the document.

returns.description: The watermark image width in EMU.

GetOpacity.description: Returns the opacity of the watermark in the document.

returns.description: The watermark opacity. This value must be from 0 to 255.

GetText.description: Returns the text of the watermark in the document.

GetTextPr.description: Returns the text properties of the watermark in the document.

GetType.description: Returns the type of the watermark in the document.

SetDirection.description: Sets the direction of the watermark in the document.

SetImageSize.description: Sets the size (width and height) of the watermark image in the document.

SetImageURL.description: Sets the image URL of the watermark in the document.

SetOpacity.description: Sets the opacity of the watermark in the document.

params.description: The watermark opacity. This value must be from 0 to 255.
